entries.41b92115c651d42c: Its distinctive feature is that, leveraging its location midway between the Kanto and Kansai regions, it set up relay bases ahead of the industry and built a relay transportation system that allows drivers to make day-trip operations. In Hamamatsu, it has opened the relay logistics hub “Connect Area Hamamatsu” jointly with Central Nippon Expressway Company, Limited. In addition, its vision states that it will maintain an in-house transportation system operated by its own vehicles, drivers and workers while improving safety and quality, and that it has a network of bases in Shizuoka Prefecture, the Kanto area and the Chukyo area, and is working on joint delivery.
